text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE 3x3 nine-panel square expression sheet of one adult character, head-and-shoulder close-ups only. Nine evenly spaced equal-size portraits with complete hair and ornaments, upright front eye-level view. Row1: neutral, soft smile, joyful open smile. Row2: surprise, concerned, sad. Row3: restrained anger, skeptical raised brow, playful one-eye wink. Clear distinct anatomically plausible expressions, identity consistent across all nine, no props, no hands, white gutters and white background, no text.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Male age 28. Messy soft black waves, thin antique-gold rounded rectangular glasses, warm reddish hazel eyes clearly visible through untinted lenses. Longer oval face, subtle broad nose tip, gentle low brows, faint smile, generous lower lip and small round chin. Warm honey-beige skin. Black softly tailored blazer over an open-neck cream linen shirt. Calm intelligent attentive demeanor. No hand touching face.
